name: Zadok
summary: A priest, the son of Ahitub, who stayed loyal to King David. He carried the ark during Absalom's revolt and anointed Solomon king.

key_moments.title: Carries the Ark Back to Jerusalem
key_moments.description: When David fled from Absalom, Zadok and the Levites came with him carrying the ark of God. David sent the ark back, and Zadok and Abiathar carried it again to Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Sends a Warning to David
key_moments.description: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar the plan Ahithophel had given Absalom. Their sons Ahimaaz and Jonathan carried the warning to David.

key_moments.title: Anointing Solomon
key_moments.description: At David's command Zadok took a horn of oil out of the tabernacle and anointed Solomon king at Gihon. The trumpet sounded and all the people rejoiced.
